cash_waterfall.relevance: Net out operating expenses; not AI attributable by default
Accounting profit after taxes; not necessarily free cash flow
Must be identified; NOT shown in consolidated earnings
Requires enacted tax, enforceable royalty or valid public ownership
Subtract mandatory costs, earmarks and reserve charges

policy_tests: Cannot count company revenue as profit or government revenue
Cannot annualize 2026 Nvidia quarter and combine with other years as observed total
Net profit is not necessarily realized distributable cash
AI attribution is unverified across observations
US-source and global-source revenue must be reconciled
Tax incidence and behavioral effects unknown
Do not treat secondary royalties and corporate profit as separate value without proving non-overlap
Recoveries owed to particular claimants cannot be swept into universal account
